entries.clue: Bundle of fibres that shortens to pull on a bone; the body holds over 600 of them
Silver of 925 parts in 1000, stamped with a lion passant
Setting so thick with tiny stones that the metal beneath vanishes
Chest pair, in the shorthand of the changing room
Gilded bird atop the pole a legion follows, and loses embarrassingly often
Bristly forest game hunted by the sackful and roasted whole for supper
Rounded caps on the shoulders, clipped from a Greek-letter shape
Glittering imitation stones sewn in rows onto an evening frock
Twisted neck ring of gold buried in hoards by Iron Age Britons
The one small Armorican holdout the occupying legions never manage to subdue
Land of rajahs the pair fly to on a rug, to end a drought
Common Roman soldier; the pair enlist as two in order to rescue a conscript
Five to the gramme for a stone; for gold, parts in twenty-four
